title: Orris Glow Brand Guidelines
summary: A refined brand identity designed for Orris Glow, a modern ear piercing studio focused on precision, safety, and effortless elegance. The visual system embraces soft neutral tones and minimalist aesthetics to create a calm, premium brand experience that resonates with style-conscious clients seeking professional, high-quality piercing services.
intent: Calm neutrals and quiet minimalism for a precision piercing studio.
